Parse: cJSON *root = cJSON_Parse(buf); cJSON *text = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, 'text'); if(cJSON_IsString(text)) use text->valuestring; cJSON *speed = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, 'speed'); if(cJSON_IsNumber(speed)) use (int)speed->valuedouble; cJSON_Delete(root);
